input.prompt: From this Snap Inc 10-K, find the table of potentially dilutive shares excluded from diluted net loss per share calculation as of December 31, 2024 (stock options, unvested RSUs and RSAs, Convertible Notes if-converted). Also find the maximum/ if-converted share count for the convertible notes, and any statement about maximum shares issuable upon conversion of the notes (2025, 2026, 2027, 2028, 2030 notes) and capped call details. Quote the exact figures and their labels. {{snap10k}}

calls.output:
# Snap Inc. FY2024 10-K: Potentially Dilutive Shares, Convertible Notes, and Capped Calls

## 1. Potentially dilutive shares excluded from diluted net loss per share

**Source:** Note 3, "Net Loss per Share." The table is titled: *"The following potentially dilutive shares were excluded from the calculation of diluted net loss per share because their effect would have been anti-dilutive:"* The column header is "As of December 31," and the figures are in thousands.

| Line item (as labeled in filing) | 2024 | 2023 | 2022 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Stock options | 680 | 1,697 | 3,159 |
| Unvested RSUs and RSAs | 134,253 | 157,130 | 132,392 |
| Convertible Notes (if-converted) | 85,945 | 89,379 | 89,379 |

The surrounding text states: "For the periods presented, our potentially dilutive shares relating to stock options, RSUs, RSAs, and Convertible Notes were not included in the computation of diluted net loss per share as the effect of including these shares in the calculation would have been anti-dilutive."

Diluted net loss per share was $(0.42) in 2024 (the basic and diluted weighted-average share counts are both 1,659,147 thousand).

## 2. Convertible Notes: if-converted share count

- **Total if-converted shares, as of December 31, 2024:** 85,945 thousand (Note 3 table, "Convertible Notes (if-converted)").
- The 10-K does not break this total out by note in the dilution table. I derived the breakdown below by multiplying each note's principal by its stated conversion rate. The derived figures sum to about 85,945 thousand, which reconciles to the filed number.

| Notes | Principal at 12/31/2024 | Conversion rate (shares per $1,000) | Implied shares (approx., thousands) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2025 Notes | $36,240K | 46.1233 | ~1,672 |
| 2026 Notes | $249,754K | 43.8481 | ~10,950 |
| 2027 Notes | $1,150,000K | 11.2042 | ~12,885 |
| 2028 Notes | $1,500,000K | 17.7494 | ~26,624 |
| 2030 Notes | $750,000K | 45.0846 | ~33,814 |

The filing also states the following about share settlement:
- "The Convertible Notes are convertible into cash, shares of our Class A common stock, or a combination of cash and shares of our Class A common stock, at our election."
- "As of December 31, 2024, the if-converted value of the Convertible Notes did not exceed the principal amount."

The 10-K does not state a single "maximum shares issuable upon conversion" figure. The 85,945 thousand if-converted figure is the closest disclosed number. Holders of the 2030 Notes are also entitled to an increase in the conversion rate in connection with a make-whole fundamental change or a redemption, but the filing does not quantify those additional shares.

## 3. Conversion terms and eligibility by note

| Note | Conversion rate (per $1,000) | Initial conversion price | Eligibility as of year-end 2024 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2025 Notes (due May 1, 2025) | 46.1233 | ~$21.68 | "The sale price requirement for conversion was not satisfied... the 2025 Notes will not be eligible for optional conversion until February 1, 2025." |
| 2026 Notes (due Aug 1, 2026) | 43.8481 | ~$22.81 | "...will not be eligible for optional conversion during the first quarter of 2025." |
| 2027 Notes (due May 1, 2027) | 11.2042 | ~$89.25 | "...will not be eligible for optional conversion during the first quarter of 2025." |
| 2028 Notes (due Mar 1, 2028) | 17.7494 | ~$56.34 | "...will not be eligible for optional conversion during the first quarter of 2025." |
| 2030 Notes (due May 1, 2030) | 45.0846 | ~$22.18 | "The sale price requirement for conversion was not satisfied as of December 31, 2024... will not be eligible for optional conversion during the first quarter of 2025." |

Principal outstanding at December 31, 2024 was $36.2M (2025), $249.8M (2026), $1.15B (2027), $1.50B (2028), and $750.0M (2030), for a total of $3,685,994K.

The 10-K also describes the dilution conditions. The Convertible Notes "would have a dilutive impact on net income per share when the average market price of Class A common stock for a given period exceeds the respective conversion price of the Convertible Notes."

## 4. Capped Call Transactions

From Note 7:

- *"...we entered into the 2025 Capped Call Transactions, the 2026 Capped Call Transactions, the 2027 Capped Call Transactions, the 2028 Capped Call Transactions, and the 2030 Capped Call Transactions (collectively, the 'Capped Call Transactions'), respectively, with certain counterparties at a net cost of $100.0 million, $102.1 million, $86.8 million, $177.0 million, and $68.9 million respectively."*
- **Cap prices (initial):** "$32.12, $32.58, $121.02, $93.90, and $33.48 per share of our Class A common stock, respectively" for the 2025, 2026, 2027, 2028, and 2030 Capped Calls.
- **Purpose:** "The Capped Call Transactions are intended to reduce potential dilution to holders of our Class A common stock beyond the conversion prices up to the cap prices on any conversion of the Convertible Notes or offset any cash payments we are required to make in excess of the principal amount, as the case may be, with such reduction or offset subject to a cap."
- **Accounting:** "The cost of the Capped Call Transactions was recorded as a reduction of our additional paid-in capital... The Capped Call Transactions will not be remeasured as long as they continue to meet the conditions for equity classification."
- **2025 termination:** "In May 2024, we entered into agreements to terminate all of the 2025 Capped Call Transactions, which resulted in $62.7 million recorded within additional paid-in capital."
- **Status:** "As of December 31, 2024, the remaining Capped Call Transactions were out-of-the-money."

## 5. Related risk-factor statements

- Risk Factors: "On the conversion of the Convertible Notes, unless we elect to deliver solely shares of our Class A common stock to settle such conversion... we will be required to make cash payments for the Convertible Notes being converted."
- Risk Factors: "We entered into certain hedging positions... These hedging positions are expected generally to reduce potential dilution of our Class A common stock on any conversion of the Convertible Notes or offset any cash payments... with such reduction or offset subject to a cap."

steps.text:
**Answer: 85,945 thousand shares (about 85.9 million Class A shares)**

Snap's FY2024 10-K reports the convertible notes' if-converted dilution as of December 31, 2024 at 85,945 thousand shares. That is the largest dilutive effect the notes could have on the share count, and it is the figure Snap excluded from diluted net loss per share because including it would have been anti-dilutive.

**Supporting figures (Note 3, "Net Loss per Share," in thousands, as of December 31, 2024):**
- Stock options: 680
- Unvested RSUs and RSAs: 134,253
- Convertible Notes (if-converted): 85,945

The 10-K does not state a single "maximum shares issuable" figure for the notes, so 85,945 is the closest disclosed number. Snap can settle conversions in cash, shares, or a combination, so this is the share-count measure rather than a guaranteed issuance.

**Reconciliation by note.** The filing does not break the total out by note in the dilution table. I derived the split by multiplying each note's principal at 12/31/2024 by its conversion rate per $1,000. The results sum to the reported total:

| Notes | Principal ($ thousands) | Conversion rate per $1,000 | Implied shares (thousands) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2025 Notes | 36,240 | 46.1233 | ~1,672 |
| 2026 Notes | 249,754 | 43.8481 | ~10,950 |
| 2027 Notes | 1,150,000 | 11.2042 | ~12,885 |
| 2028 Notes | 1,500,000 | 17.7494 | ~26,624 |
| 2030 Notes | 750,000 | 45.0846 | ~33,814 |
| **Total** | **3,685,994** | | **≈85,945** |

Total principal is $3,685,994 thousand, and the 2030 Notes carry an additional make-whole conversion-rate increase that the filing does not quantify.

**Context.** The capped call transactions were meant to reduce dilution up to their cap prices, and they were out-of-the-money at year-end 2024. The 85,945 figure is the gross if-converted count and does not reflect that offset.

            "name": "Snap Inc. Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2024 (SEC EDGAR)"
        }
    ]
}
